mapper.sql: FROM admin_account a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role r ON r.user_id=u.id AND r.enabled=1

a.id,a.user_id,a.username,a.enabled,'platform_admin' AS role_code,IF(u.user_status='active' AND r.role_code='admin' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_account_role ar JOIN admin_role g ON g.id=ar.admin_role_id WHERE ar.admin_account_id=a.id AND g.enabled=1 AND g.role_code='platform_admin'),1,0) AS identity_enabled,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(a.last_login_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') AS last_login_at,SHA2(JSON_ARRAY(a.id,a.user_id,a.username,a.enabled,r.role_code,u.user_status,a.updated_at),256) AS snapshot_token
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)
SELECT ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT WHERE a.id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*)
SELECT ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT WHERE d.id=#{id}
mapper.sql: FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role r ON r.user_id=u.id AND r.enabled=1 LEFT JOIN user_realname_verification n ON n.id=(SELECT id FROM user_realname_verification WHERE user_id=u.id ORDER BY submitted_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN user_student_verification s ON s.id=(SELECT id FROM user_student_verification WHERE user_id=u.id ORDER BY submitted_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1)

u.id AS user_id,u.nickname,IF(u.phone IS NULL,NULL,CONCAT(LEFT(u.phone,3),'****',RIGHT(u.phone,4))) AS phone_masked,u.user_status,u.register_status AS registration_status,r.role_code AS business_role,n.verification_status AS realname_status,IF(s.verification_status='approved' AND s.expire_at<=#{at},'expired',s.verification_status) AS student_status,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') AS created_at

WHERE 1=1 AND u.id!='3e8c4a5e468449709003045cd6dfca76' AND u.user_status=#{filter.status} AND (u.id=#{filter.keyword} OR LOCATE(#{filter.keyword},u.nickname)>0 OR u.phone=#{filter.keyword}) AND IF(s.verification_status='approved' AND s.expire_at<=#{at},'expired',s.verification_status)=#{filter.studentStatus}

SELECT ORDER BY u.created_at DESC,u.id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT WHERE u.id=#{id} AND u.id!='3e8c4a5e468449709003045cd6dfca76'

SELECT id,parent_id,menu_name,menu_type,permission_code,route_path,component_path,icon_name,visible,enabled,sort_no,SHA2(JSON_ARRAY(id,parent_id,menu_name,menu_type,permission_code,route_path,component_path,icon_name,visible,enabled,sort_no),256) AS snapshot_token FROM admin_menu WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT admin_menu_id FROM admin_role_menu WHERE admin_role_id=#{roleId} ORDER BY admin_menu_id
SELECT id FROM admin_role WHERE id=#{id} AND role_code='platform_admin' AND enabled=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM admin_account WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM platform_rule_document WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(expire_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') FROM user_student_verification WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY submitted_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT rule_version FROM user_rule_acceptance WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY rule_version
SELECT operation_reason AS reason,result_message,before_snapshot_json AS before_json,after_snapshot_json AS after_json FROM admin_operation_audit WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT COUNT(IF(case_status='pending',1,NULL)) AS pending,COUNT(IF(case_status='waiting_user',1,NULL)) AS waiting_user,COUNT(IF(case_status='waiting_factory',1,NULL)) AS waiting_factory,COUNT(IF(case_status NOT IN('closed','cancelled') AND DATE(deadline_at)=DATE(#{at}),1,NULL)) AS due_today FROM admin_case WHERE created_at<=#{at}
SELECT case_type,COUNT(*) AS count FROM admin_case WHERE created_at<=#{at} AND case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled') GROUP BY case_type ORDER BY case_type

SELECT reason_code,COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT 'CHANNEL_FREEZE_OPEN' AS reason_code FROM payment_channel_suborder WHERE freeze_alert_status='open' AND updated_at<=#{at} UNION ALL SELECT 'REFUND_FAILED' FROM refund_order WHERE refund_status='failed' AND updated_at<=#{at}) channels GROUP BY reason_code ORDER BY reason_code

SELECT c.id AS case_id,c.title,CASE r.relation_type WHEN 'factory_onboarding' THEN '01' WHEN 'rental_order' THEN '04' WHEN 'payment_order' THEN '04' WHEN 'refund_order' THEN '04' WHEN 'compensation_receivable' THEN '04' WHEN 'order_issue' THEN '05' WHEN 'extension_application' THEN '04' WHEN 'transport_order' THEN '05' WHEN 'return_verification' THEN '05' WHEN 'claim' THEN '06' WHEN 'arbitration_case' THEN '06' WHEN 'custom_requirement' THEN '11' WHEN 'custom_quote' THEN '11' WHEN 'custom_order' THEN '11' WHEN 'custom_after_sale' THEN '11' WHEN 'sys_user' THEN '01' WHEN 'realname_verification' THEN '01' WHEN 'student_verification' THEN '01' WHEN 'factory_onboarding_audit' THEN '01' WHEN 'prop_sku_audit' THEN '02' WHEN 'order_issue_report' THEN '05' ELSE '08' END AS source_module,r.relation_id AS source_id,c.case_status,CASE r.relation_type WHEN 'factory_onboarding' THEN (SELECT src.audit_status FROM factory_onboarding_audit src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'rental_order' THEN (SELECT src.order_status FROM rental_order src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'payment_order' THEN (SELECT src.payment_status FROM payment_order src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'refund_order' THEN (SELECT src.refund_status FROM refund_order src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'compensation_receivable' THEN (SELECT src.receivable_status FROM order_compensation_receivable src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'order_issue' THEN (SELECT src.issue_status FROM order_issue_report src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'extension_application' THEN (SELECT src.extension_status FROM order_extension_request src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'transport_order' THEN (SELECT src.leg_status FROM order_transport_leg src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'return_verification' THEN (SELECT src.check_status FROM order_return_check src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'claim' THEN (SELECT src.claim_status FROM order_claim src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'arbitration_case' THEN (SELECT src.case_status FROM arbitration_case src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'custom_requirement' THEN (SELECT src.requirement_status FROM custom_requirement src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'custom_quote' THEN (SELECT src.quote_status FROM custom_quote src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'custom_order' THEN (SELECT src.order_status FROM custom_order src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'custom_after_sale' THEN (SELECT src.after_sale_status FROM custom_after_sale_request src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'sys_user' THEN (SELECT src.user_status FROM sys_user src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'realname_verification' THEN (SELECT src.verification_status FROM user_realname_verification src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'student_verification' THEN (SELECT src.verification_status FROM user_student_verification src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'factory_onboarding_audit' THEN (SELECT src.audit_status FROM factory_onboarding_audit src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'prop_sku_audit' THEN (SELECT src.audit_status FROM prop_sku_audit src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) WHEN 'order_issue_report' THEN (SELECT src.issue_status FROM order_issue_report src WHERE src.id=r.relation_id) ELSE NULL END AS source_status,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(c.deadline_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') AS deadline_at FROM admin_case c LEFT JOIN admin_case_relation r ON r.admin_case_id=c.id AND r.is_primary=1 WHERE c.case_status IN ('pending','waiting_user','waiting_factory') AND c.created_at<=#{at} ORDER BY c.deadline_at IS NULL,c.deadline_at,c.updated_at DESC,c.id LIMIT 20
SELECT id AS usage_id,user_coupon_id,checkout_batch_id,payment_order_id AS payment_id FROM coupon_usage WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT factory_id,sku_id,rental_order_id,eligible_rent_amount_fen,allocated_discount_amount_fen FROM coupon_allocation WHERE coupon_usage_id=#{id} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET coupon_status='invalid',invalid_reason=#{input.reason},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND coupon_status=#{input.expectedStatus} AND coupon_status IN ('available','returned')
UPDATE admin_account SET enabled=#{enabled},updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE platform_rule_document SET rule_code=#{input.ruleCode},rule_title=#{input.ruleTitle},rule_version=#{input.ruleVersion},rule_scope=#{input.ruleScope},content_type=#{input.contentType},content_text=#{input.contentText},content_url=#{input.contentUrl},is_required=#{input.isRequired},force_reaccept=#{input.forceReaccept},content_hash=SHA2(COALESCE(#{input.contentText},#{input.contentUrl}),256),updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND rule_status='draft'
UPDATE platform_rule_document SET rule_status='archived',updated_at=#{at} WHERE rule_code=#{code} AND rule_status='active'
UPDATE platform_rule_document SET rule_status='active',effective_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND rule_status='draft'

SELECT ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC
